parts.title: Historian Hysteria
parts.summary: Reconcile two equal-length columns of integer location IDs by sorting each list independently in ascending order, pairing elements by rank, and summing the absolute differences across all pairs.
parts.algorithmSummary: Typed-array numeric sort & linear zip: copy left and right columns from immutable LocationLists into private Float64Arrays, call native numeric .sort(), and sum |L[i] - R[i]| with safe-integer overflow validation; differentially verified against a 1D Wasserstein CDF sweep oracle.
parts.complexity: O(N log N) time, O(N) space
learnings: Preserving raw unsorted left and right columns in 2024/day01/shared/LocationLists keeps Part 2 frequency similarity zero-churn.
Sorting private Float64Array copies avoids JavaScript's lexicographic Array.prototype.sort() footgun while covering all safe integers.
A 1D Wasserstein CDF sweep over net multiplicities provides a completely independent differential test oracle for rank-paired distances.
